title: A House of Prayer

skills.key_step: The child says when Christians pray during the day and what a simple prayer says (Matthew 21:13).

floor.question: Say a short prayer before eating.
floor.answer: Thank you God for the food. Amen

representations: prayer cards: thank you, please, sorry

board.do: Draw a sun rising, a plate and a moon.

board.say: Can we pray at this time?

board.do: Wait for the child to say yes, before eating.
Write a simple prayer for each time.
